notes: Actor-goal list: 11 candidate use cases across the five actors, one per goal.

value.name: Draft Product Brief
value.description: The founder answers guided Brief questions so the pipeline can build a Product Brief before SRS work starts.

value.name: Run Guided Pipeline Step
value.description: The founder walks through intake, elicit and draft for the current pipeline step until it reaches its gate.

value.name: Accept Step At Gate
value.description: The founder reviews a step's draft output at the gate and accepts it, moving the pipeline to the next step.

value.name: Request Step Revision
value.description: The founder asks the pipeline to redraft the current step's output with a specific correction.

ops.reason: S-3.2 goal: fix a step's draft

value.name: Export SRS Document
value.description: The founder downloads the assembled SRS as a Word document, watermarked until baseline.

ops.reason: S-3.2 goal: get the SRS out of the tool

value.name: View Readiness Flags
value.description: The founder reviews open red and yellow flags to know what still blocks baseline.

ops.reason: S-3.2 goal: know what is unresolved

value.name: View User List
value.description: The admin reviews the read-only list of registered users and their plan status.

ops.reason: S-3.2 goal: admin oversight of users

value.name: View AI Cost Metrics
value.description: The admin reviews aggregated AI token and credit spend across projects.

ops.reason: S-3.2 goal: admin oversight of AI cost

value.name: Process Credit Purchase
value.description: The payment gateway confirms a credit purchase and the ledger records the settled amount.

value.name: Render Diagram
value.description: The render service compiles a diagram's PlantUML source into SVG/PNG and returns the result.

ops.reason: S-3.2 goal: produce a diagram image

value.name: Expire Stale Credit Reservations
value.description: The scheduler releases credit reservations that were never finalized after their expiry window.
